title: Disable platform-clock override
name: disable-hpet
warning: Advanced setting. Removes the useplatformclock boot override; this does not disable the physical HPET timer.
description: Removes the forced platform-clock override and returns Windows to normal timer-source selection.
deepDescription: Runs bcdedit /deletevalue useplatformclock so Windows is not forced to use the platform clock. Results depend on the hardware, firmware, Windows build, and timer configuration; no universal FPS or input-lag improvement is guaranteed.
